About UJPSME-NM

A regional home for ME students

UJPSME-NM is the regional federation of Junior Philippine Society of Mechanical Engineers chapters across Northern Mindanao. It coordinates shared programs, promotes student welfare across chapters, and builds connections between students, alumni, and industry region-wide.

Vision To be the leading regional federation in Mindanao — uniting mechanical engineering students, strengthening every member chapter, and shaping the future of the field across Northern Mindanao.

What We Do

Regional programs

The core programs UJPSME-NM runs across every member chapter.

General Assembly

The regional gathering where chapters convene, elect leaders, and set the year's direction together.

Industry Exposure

Plant visits and company engagements opened up to every member chapter across the region.

Competitions

Regional quiz bowls, CAD contests, and design meets that pit chapters against each other in friendly rivalry.

Sports

Inter-chapter sports fests that build camaraderie between students across Northern Mindanao.
